description: List the location categories that scope noaa_climate_find_locations — CITY, CLIM_DIV, CLIM_REG, CNTRY, CNTY, HYD_ACC, HYD_CAT, HYD_REG, HYD_SUB, ST, US_TERR, and ZIP. Call this first when you do not know which locationCategoryId to pass, including the hydrological categories needed to reach a basin or region. There are 12 categories in total. This endpoint takes pagination and sort only — NOAA CDO ignores dataset, location, station, and date filters here, so none are offered.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–1000). Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return for pagination. Defaults to 0.

sortField.description: Sort results by this field. Optional.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Optional; defaults to asc.

name: noaa_climate_list_location_categories

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `service_unavailable`: NOAA CDO API is unreachable or returning errors. `rate_limited`: NOAA CDO throttled the request — the configured token went over its rate limit. `upstream_auth_failed`: NOAA CDO rejected the API token this server is configured with. `validation_error`: A pagination or sort parameter is not recognized by the NOAA CDO API. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhausted.description: True when the requested offset is past the end of a non-empty result set — the page is empty but matches exist. Omitted otherwise.

metadata.description: Pagination metadata. Present when the API returns it.

resultset.description: Pagination cursor fields for this response.

count.description: Total number of matching location categories.

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

offset.description: Zero-based starting index of this page, echoing the requested offset.

notice.description: Guidance when no location categories were returned. Omitted otherwise.

id.description: Location category ID, passed as locationCategoryId to noaa_climate_find_locations (e.g., CITY, ST, HYD_REG).

totalCount.description: Total number of location categories before the page limit.

title: List NOAA Climate Location Categories
